subject: Request: access trail demo + data-scrub plan for SIG review
messages:
From: Susan Martin <susan.martin@crestline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access trail demo + data-scrub plan for SIG review

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing for a SIG questionnaire and need to validate the admin/activity evidence you can provide for Crestline's procurement review. Specifically:  
- A short demo (30–45m) of the access/admin trail (what events are captured, how they map to SIG controls)  
- A sample extract of admin events (timestamped) so our security team can confirm fields and formats  
- Your recommended plan for removing or redacting PII from exported logs prior to handing to third parties (we call this a "scrub plan")

Can you confirm:  
1) Which admin events are in the default audit stream (console actions, API key events, role changes, operator ledger, model deployments, inference metadata, etc.)  
2) Default retention for hosted accounts vs. Dedicated/Private deployments and whether retention is configurable per customer  
3) Export formats you support (NDJSON, CSV, gzipped bundles) and chain-of-custody options (signed manifests, checksums)

We'd like to run the demo this week if possible. If you need us to sign an NDA or DPA before sharing samples, tell us and we'll route it to procurement.

Thanks,
Susan Martin
Security Review Lead — Crestline Health
[susan.martin@crestline.com]

[Attachment requested: sample admin events CSV]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Martin <susan.martin@crestline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access trail demo + data-scrub plan for SIG review

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear list. Happy to run the demo and share a sanitized sample. Short answers up front, followed by next steps:  

1) Default audit events (hosted): console sign-ins, console actions (create/delete roles, grant/revoke permissions), API key lifecycle (create/revoke), operator ledger entries (deployment/rollback events), model config changes (version/pinning), and request metadata (request_id, model_id, timestamp, token count, latency). We do NOT include full prompt text or response content in the admin stream for hosted tiers by default.  

2) Retention: hosted default 90 days for high-volume token events; admin and operator ledgers are retained 365 days by default but can be configured. Dedicated/Private: retention is configurable per contract (we commonly provide 1–7 years options and snapshot exports for legal hold).

3) Export formats & custody: NDJSON or CSV exports, gzipped bundles with SHA256 manifests, and PKCS7-signed transfer bundles on request. For high-assurance deliveries we provide a signed manifest and a notarized timestamp (S3 presigned + manifest).

PII scrub: we recommend a three-stage scrub plan — field-level redaction (email, IP), tokenization for identifiers, and sampling review. I'll attach our scrub-plan template and a small, already-sanitized sample admin events CSV.

Next steps:  
- I can run a 30m demo with our security engineer (Marissa) + SRE (Rishi) on Tue or Wed afternoon.
- I'll drop a sanitized sample + scrub-plan template to a secure Drive link (or send after DPA if you prefer).
- If Crestline wants legal-hold export format details (ndjson + manifest), Marissa can share SOP for packaging.

Proposed times: Tue 04/06 2pm PT or Wed 04/07 3pm PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access-trail-sample.csv (sanitized)]

Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply and the details. Wed 04/07 3pm PT works for us.  

Couple of clarifications for the demo:  
- For the scrub plan, our legal team wants assurance that IP addresses and user_email are removed before any logs leave Redwood unless explicitly required by a legal hold. Is that done automatically for hosted samples you share, or will your team perform manual redaction?  
- For dedicated/private customers, we may ask for a chain-of-custody export that includes a signed manifest and timestamps. Can you confirm how long it takes to generate a notarized bundle?

Also we can route a DPA if required; procurement is copied on this thread (procurement@crestline.com).

Best,
Susan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Martin <susan.martin@crestline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access trail demo + data-scrub plan for SIG review

Hi Susan — looping in Rishi (SRE) to confirm the technical timeline and our export SOP. Short answers:  

- Hosted sanitized samples: we automatically redact user_email and anonymize IPs for any demo/sample exports. The access-trail-sample.csv I shared is produced by our scrubbing pipeline (field hash + truncation) — see attached notes.  
- For Dedicated/Private legal-hold bundles: generating a notarized bundle (signed manifest + gzipped NDJSON) is typically a 24–48 hour operation once we've validated the scope and confirmed required time window. We run checksums and a PKCS7 signature as standard for high-assurance deliveries.

Attachments included here: scrub-plan-template.docx (recommended procedures and field mappings), log-export-sop.pdf (operational steps for generating NDJSON bundles and chain-of-custody). We'll also attach a short checklist for legal hold requests.  

For the demo on Wed 04/07 3pm PT — invite sent (calendar link) and Rishi will share our runbook deck. If your procurement/legal wants a DPA before samples, we can pause the sample link and send after signature.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Engineering — Redwood Inference

[Attachments: scrub-plan-template.docx (DOCX, 42KB), log-export-sop.pdf (PDF, 88KB)]
